rationale: The corroborated transfer records account for the identified packet’s archive handling during the recorded post-assembly interval. This bounded claim requires no inference about internal arrangement or earlier assembly history.

signal_basis.exact_text: After the completed D-17 packet entered a sealed archive box, reliable handlers record its shelf-to-reading-room and return transfers.
Independent signatures and intact seals corroborate each transfer; the packet is the same packet throughout the three-day archive-loan interval.
No opening, alteration or assembly event is observed during this interval.
